signature: DOUBLE PRECISION FUNCTION ZLANTR( NORM, UPLO, DIAG, M, N, A, LDA,

params.name: norm
params.reference: Specifies the value to be returned in ZLANTR as described above.

params.name: uplo
params.reference:
Specifies whether the matrix A is upper or lower trapezoidal.

-   `= 'U'`: Upper trapezoidal
-   `= 'L'`: Lower trapezoidal Note that A is triangular instead of trapezoidal if $M = N$.

params.name: diag
params.reference:
Specifies whether or not the matrix A has unit diagonal.

-   `= 'N'`: Non-unit diagonal
-   `= 'U'`: Unit diagonal

params.name: M
params.reference: The number of rows of the matrix A. $M \ge 0$, and if `UPLO = 'U'`, $M \le N$. When $M = 0$, ZLANTR is set to zero.

params.name: N
params.reference: The number of columns of the matrix A. $N \ge 0$, and if `UPLO = 'L'`, $N \le M$. When $N = 0$, ZLANTR is set to zero.

params.name: A
params.reference: The trapezoidal matrix A (A is triangular if $M = N$). If `UPLO = 'U'`, the leading m by n upper trapezoidal part of the array A contains the upper trapezoidal matrix, and the strictly lower triangular part of A is not referenced. If `UPLO = 'L'`, the leading m by n lower trapezoidal part of the array A contains the lower trapezoidal matrix, and the strictly upper triangular part of A is not referenced. Note that when `DIAG = 'U'`, the diagonal elements of A are not referenced and are assumed to be one.

params.name: lda
params.reference: The leading dimension of the array A. $\mathrm{LDA} \ge \max (M,1)$.

params.name: WORK
params.reference: where $\mathrm{LWORK} \ge M$ when `NORM = 'I'`; otherwise, `WORK` is not referenced.

notes: no derivable minimum length for workspace WORK
